_: The layer of a module is the directory it sits in. A module may import only from a strictly lower layer, plus layer 0. No sibling imports, ever. Enforced by tools/layers.mjs, run from `make check`. When two modules in a layer need each other, the shared thing moves DOWN a layer — that is the whole conflict-resolution procedure.
_guest: Layer 99 means NOT ON THE STACK AT ALL. These are classic scripts served into the sandboxed page box, where a module script cannot load and there is nothing to import — so they share a registry global instead of an import graph, and the layering gate has no edges to check. They are listed anyway so a file here resolves to a layer rather than to nothing.
